name: Yang Guang Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yang Guang Co.,Ltd. is a prominent Chinese enterprise specializing in property development and management. The company's work encompasses both the construction of high-end residential housing and a variety of commercial projects. Its commercial portfolio features a diverse range of properties, including residential complexes, hotels, office buildings, apartment blocks, and integrated urban developments. Originally known as Super Shine Co., Ltd., the company adopted its current name, Yang Guang Co.,Ltd., in 2008. Established in 1993, its operational base is located in Beijing, China.
